entities.name: Bramming–Tønder railway line
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Bramming–Tønder railway line is a 67.9 kilometres (42.2 mi) long railway line in Denmark which runs through the historical region of Southern Jutland between Bramming and the German border just south of Tønder. The standard gauge railway line is single track and unelectrified.
